name: play_fishing
description: A deterministic real-world fishing and ecology field journal. Travel through real habitats, identify native and introduced species, automatically release protected wildlife, record scientific observations, and encounter location-specific debris or empty casts. Actions: status, shop, buy, cast, goto, inventory, sell, encyclopedia, journal, look, batch. Prefer batch casts with times and stop_on instead of one cast per message. Every result ends with a compact 📊 status JSON line.

action.description: Action to perform. dive starts an expedition after buying oxygen; choose resolves a paused major underwater site; surface ends the expedition.

choice.description: For choose: option number, starting at 1. Omit to show current choices again.

bait_id.description: For buy/cast: bait id such as basic_worm, glow_bait, golden_lure, or oxygen. Cast omits bait to use the cheapest available bait; dive does not use bait.

times.description: For cast/dive: number of repeated steps, 1-20. Returns one compact summary.

stop_on.description: Early stop conditions for repeated cast/dive: new species, rare-or-better catch, or event. Resources running out also stops.

target.description: For sell: catch id such as c_007, all, species <fish_id>, or item <item_id>.

location_id.description: For goto: location id such as reed_river. Omit to list all locations.

chest_uid.description: For open: pending chest uid such as ch_001, shown in inventory.

id.description: For look: object id or English display name for a fish, location, bait, season, or item. Undiscovered fish show as ???.

steps.description: For batch: up to 8 queued action objects. Example: [{"action":"buy","bait_id":"basic_worm","qty":10},{"action":"cast","times":10}].
